If you’re looking for the ability to do yoga and more on your time, this is the place to go. With so many choices and ability levels, you can definitely find lots of classes to suit your needs.

reviews.text:
Best yoga app when I’m not locked out. I have been locked out of this app multiple times. I wouldn’t deduct stars for that if there were a way to resolve it, but when I was locked out and lost something like six months of a one year subscription, I didn’t appreciate that. I called the App Store bit was told they couldn’t resolve the issue, I had to contact the app creators. But when you go through the app, there’s no way to contact them, at least not when you’re locked out. I was using the same login that I used the first six months, but the app said the credentials were not recognized. 

Because this is the best yoga app I’ve ever found, I subscribed again this month. I used a different email, given the problems with the last login. Everything was fine until the app said that there was another account for me and that I needed to use that login, and then the app logged me out. I tried logging back in with the old login, but it wouldn’t accept my credentials. I tried the old email with the new password, but nothing. I tried the new email with the old password and so on, but I was locked out again. Luckily, I opened the app today after a few weeks of not touching it, and was logged in. But I have no idea what will happen if I’m weirdly logged out again. 

The yoga classes and everything else are the best I’ve found, but frustratingly I can only access them about 50% of the time. And that’s from at least 2 different iPads w/2 different ip addresses. If this continues, I will sadly have to cancel the subscription and settle for the next best thing. As it is, I have no idea what my login is, because it’s never accepted any of my credentials with the new subscription. 

TO THE DEVELOPERS: Please allow people to contact you when they are locked out of the app. I understand things can get buggy, which is why it’s important to add a “contact the developers” option when the app won’t accept credentials. Otherwise, thank you for a beautiful app.
